title: Starting From $0 in 2027? Here’s How I’d Invest Step-by-Step
description:

Thinking about investing but have no clue where to start? Don’t worry, I’ve got you. In this video, I’m breaking down exactly what I’d do if I were starting from scratch — from why investing beats just saving, to what beginners should actually invest in (spoiler: index funds + ETFs), how much to put in, and a step-by-step walkthrough of buying your first stock using Fidelity. I’ll also share simple strategies to avoid panic-selling, grow your money over time, and actually start building real wealth — without all the confusing Wall Street jargon.

0:31 - Don’t Save, Invest
